description: Land Acquisition - Pelawatta & Embalapola, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, including boundaries, extents, and location details, for the purpose of taking immediate possession of these lands. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
